summary: This is a YAML configuration file for a Reveal.js presentation (a tool for making slideshows). It's setting up the presentation so that headings with three hash marks (###) become the top-level slides, rather than the usual two hash marks (##). This lets you organize your content with more granular control over what appears on each slide.

explanations.8: The slide-level property tells Reveal.js which heading level should define individual slides — setting it to 3 means each ### heading starts a new slide instead of the default ## headings.
